title: Projection agreement at the coefficient unit in canonical shift and unit coordinates
statement: Fix the finite setting P=projectionSetting F C E n and an affine scheme Y of separated finite type over F.k, with structure morphism aY. For every dimension d, let p:A^d_Y → Y be the ordered affine projection and Q the degree-zero ordinary coefficient unit. Let K be Q compared to the pro-etale site, and let r be the specified smooth-purity reassociation from [def-pur-smooth-purity-map]. Let e:Lp*(K) ≅ 1 be exact pullback of projectionUnitRaw followed by inverse exact/left-derived comparison and the derived pullback-unit map. After cancelling r, tensoring e, and the left unitor in the source of projectionAffineInPresentation, the coefficient-unit affine comparison equals the inverse of the specified diagonal orientation [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object]. The auxiliary proof hunit supplies the existing finite-Tor property of Q and introduces no choice of orientation or endpoint map.

proof.text: Specialize the existing projection_presentation_coordinate equality to K equal to the compared degree-zero coefficient unit and its canonical bounded-below witness. The supplied hunit is its finite-Tor proof. This writes projectionAffineInPresentation as the canonical reassociation followed by the displayed smooth-purity tensor map.

proof.text: Expand smoothPurityTensorMapInPresentation: its two factors are tensoring the inverse specified diagonal orientation and smoothPurityTheta. Apply smoothPurityTheta_unit to identify the latter factor with tensoring the actual pullback-unit map e followed by the left unitor.

proof.text: Apply naturality of the natural transformation obtained by tensoring e and then naturality of the left unitor. These move the inverse orientation through the unit constraints. Cancel the reassociation, tensor-unit isomorphism and unitor with their inverses. The remaining arrow is precisely the inverse specified diagonal orientation. The same formal cancellation works when d=0.

theorem projection_unit_presentation_normalization
    (F : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : F.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : IntermediateField (Padic C.l) C.Qbar) [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E]
    (n : ℕ) (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of F.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] (d : ℕ)
    (hunit : Etale.DerivedCategory.constructibleFiniteTor
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (projectionSetting F C E n).Coefficient) Y
      (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit (projectionSetting F C E n).Coefficient Y)) :
  let P := projectionSetting F C E n
  letI := (ProEtale.AffineSpacePurity.projection_geometry Y d).1
  letI := (ProEtale.AffineSpacePurity.projection_geometry Y d).2
  letI := projection_smooth Y d
  let K := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
    (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit P.Coefficient Y)
  let Kp : ProEtale.AffineSpacePurity.Plus P.Coefficient Y :=
    ⟨K, (ProEtale.DerivedCategory.plusEtaleOrigin_mapDerivedCategory_obj
      (P.diagonalUnitPlus Y)).plus⟩
  let e :=
    (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
        (iteratedAffineLineProj Y d)).mapDerivedCategory.mapIso
        (X := K) (projectionUnitRaw P.Coefficient Y) ≪≫
      (ProEtale.leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) (iteratedAffineLineProj Y d)).symm.app _ ≪≫
      ProEtale.leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) (iteratedAffineLineProj Y d)
  let r := P.smoothPurityReassociation (iteratedAffineLine Y d) d
    ((P.smoothPurityPullback (iteratedAffineLineProj Y d)).obj K)
  (r ≪≫ ((curriedTensor (_root_.DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (iteratedAffineLine Y d))
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)))).mapIso e).app
          (P.diagonalTwist (iteratedAffineLine Y d) d) ≪≫
      λ_ (P.diagonalTwist (iteratedAffineLine Y d) d)).inv ≫
    projectionAffineInPresentation F C E n Y aY Kp
      (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit P.Coefficient Y) hunit (Iso.refl _) d =
    (P.diagonalDualizingObject d (iteratedAffineLineProj Y d) aY).inv
